name: 呆小路
evolution: 呆小路 → 舞动路路 Lv.26 → 白发路路 Lv.40
description: 幼年期较长，主要靠嗅闻、聆听和头上叶子的触觉来获取信息。头顶毛发会散发出爆米花的香味，偶尔引来其他精灵。它们之间用互闻头顶代表问候。
descriptionEn: Its juvenile period is long; it mainly obtains information by smelling, listening, and the touch of the leaf on its head. The hair on top emits a popcorn scent, occasionally attracting other creatures. They greet each other by sniffing each other's heads.
